summary: Wrote test/graph-store.test.js — 65 assertions covering open, appendEvent (all 7 event types, actor tracking, malformed-line skip, checkpoint loading), compact (terminal compaction, idempotency), and initGitAttributes (create/append/idempotency). Two bugs found and fixed in lib/graph-store.js during testing: (1) appendEvent didn't create the parent directory for slash-containing nodeIds like dc3ec43f/3 — added mkdirSync before writeFileSync; (2) loadGraph and compact used non-recursive readdirSync so files in subdirs were invisible — switched to {recursive:true}.
